module_title: Core Hubs, Major Initiatives, and Indices
introduction: NITI Aayog operates through specialized hubs and drives governance improvements by publishing critical performance indices. This advanced level explores its functional machinery and flagship programs.

core_concepts.title: The Two Core Hubs
core_concepts.description:
NITI Aayog's operations are divided into two main hubs: 
1. Team India Hub: Acts as the interface between States and the Center, ensuring cooperative federalism. 
2. Knowledge and Innovation Hub: Acts as the core 'think-tank', maintaining a state-of-the-art resource center and promoting research.

core_concepts.title: Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP)
core_concepts.description: Launched in 2018, this is NITI Aayog's flagship program to rapidly transform 112 most under-developed districts across the country. It focuses on Health & Nutrition, Education, Agriculture, Financial Inclusion, and Basic Infrastructure.

core_concepts.title: Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)
core_concepts.description: A flagship initiative to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship. Under this, 'Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs)' are established in schools to foster curiosity and creativity in young minds.

core_concepts.title: Major Indices Published by NITI Aayog
core_concepts.description:
To promote 'Competitive Federalism', NITI Aayog publishes numerous rankings: 
1. SDG India Index (Sustainable Development Goals). 
2. State Health Index. 
3. Composite Water Management Index. 
4. Export Preparedness Index. 
5. India Innovation Index.

important_entities.name: 7 Pillars of Effective Governance
important_entities.significance: NITI Aayog is based on 7 pillars: Pro-People, Pro-Activity, Participation, Empowering, Inclusion of all, Equality, and Transparency.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: UPSC frequently tests which organization publishes which report. Do not confuse NITI Aayog's indices with those published by international bodies (like the World Bank or WEF). Memorize the 'SDG India Index' and 'State Health Index' specifically as NITI Aayog products.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Team India connects, Knowledge Hub thinks
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Team India Hub is the communication bridge (States + Center). Knowledge Hub is the brain (Research + Data).

exam_strategy_tips: 'Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)' is frequently asked in Science & Tech and Economics sections. Always remember it operates under the umbrella of NITI Aayog.
